fusions.name: Seam Piercer
fusions.desc: A single claw thrust that deals 36 damage, ignores the target's armour and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hide Pricks
fusions.desc: Jabs every enemy within 2 tiles for 3 damage. Each hit has a 20% chance of [Sundered], shattering the target's armour for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Quill Hide
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, who is also left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Eye for the Gap
fusions.desc: Your critical strike chance rises by 10%. It also hardens your armour by 8%, permanently.
